Name: Nyapu Style Portrait for Nature In The Valley
Author: solangeloz
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Since there wasn't a nyapu portrait for Ivy and I didn't want any style inconsistencies in my game, I edited Evelyn's portrait a little to make this :)[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions (taken from Nyapu)[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8] 1. Install a supported version of the original MOD and check for startup errors.
﻿ 2. Unzip "Nyapuish NatureInTheValley Portrait"
﻿﻿ 3. Overwrite the folder inside with the same name folder of the original MOD.
﻿ ﻿4. Launch StardewModding API and play.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Nature In The Valley (Catchable Creatures) and its dependencies.[/color]
